rationale: Survey Draftsperson in de Witt Consulting's Gosford office: preparing set out, deposited, detail and identification plans and checking drawings for accuracy, consistency and completeness with the surveyors.

The only stated requirement is experience using AutoCAD Civil 3D plus accuracy, organisation and teamwork; no minimum years are stated. Marc's Advanced Diploma (road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater documentation in Civil 3D and AutoCAD) and his drawing review and site records work in the Philippines meet these at entry level.
Survey plan types and surveying industry knowledge are only highly regarded, and they are Marc's main gap; Gosford NSW is interstate, so relocation is discussable only.
caution: Civil 3D use is academic, not paid production drafting. No survey plan (deposited, detail, identification) experience. Interstate move to the Central Coast needs Marc's confirmation. SEEK asks years as a Survey Draftsperson: the honest answer is none in a paid role.
gaps: No paid survey drafting; Civil 3D and AutoCAD use is from study
